name: procesio
description: Lets your own AI assistant build, run, validate and audit PROCESIO processes, forms and documents.
long_description: procesio-cli is a command-line tool and MCP server for the PROCESIO automation platform. With it, your own AI assistant can build, run, validate and audit PROCESIO processes, forms and documents, from a terminal or over MCP. Open source, Apache-2.0 licence. Source: https://github.com/Procesio-Externals/procesio-cli. Docs: https://docs.procesio.com
